leaders.notes: 14th president; in office at the start of 1996, included to anchor the succession chain. Led the institution through its 1989-1993 transition from Texas A&I into the Texas A&M University System.

leaders.priorTitle: Dean, School of Business
leaders.notes: Named acting president Feb 1999 and president Oct 27, 1999; resigned June 2006 amid a spending scandal that led to criminal charges. Had been dean of TSU's business school.

leaders.priorTitle: Executive Vice Chancellor (system-level administrator)
leaders.notes: 12th president, June 6, 2016 to Feb 4, 2020. Came from the Lone Star College System and left after board tension; later became chancellor of SIU Carbondale.

leaders.priorTitle: Chief Financial Officer / Vice President for Finance
leaders.notes: Interim president between Lane and Crumpton-Young, promoted from TSU's own finance leadership.

leaders.priorTitle: Provost and Senior Vice President for Academic Affairs

leaders.priorTitle: President Emerita
leaders.notes: Interim president following Crumpton-Young's retirement; had previously served as president of Kentucky State University (2004-2014) and chaired TSU's board transition committee.

leaders.priorTitle: President
leaders.notes: 14th president; a retired U.S. Navy vice admiral who served as the 43rd Judge Advocate General of the Navy (2015-2018) and then president of Felician University (until April 2023) before taking office June 1, 2024. Sitting president; no active search.

leaders.notes: 9th president; over two decades Texas State gained R2 Carnegie classification, emerging-research-university status, and HSI designation. A campus building was later named in her and her husband's honor.
